summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K on 2026-09-08 reporting weekly share repurchases executed from 31 August to 4 September 2026. Purchases totaled 258,500 ordinary shares: 200,000 on US trading venues and 58,500 on London venues, with Goldman Sachs as counterparty. Prices ranged from USD 105.60 to USD 108.925 and GBP 78.40 to GBP 80.65 per share. The repurchases are part of a EUR 1 billion buyback programme announced 17 February 2026; all repurchased shares will be cancelled. The programme reflects ongoing shareholder capital returns. No premium, board recommendation, or termination terms apply.
